title: Morning Headlines
intro: A major earthquake in the Philippines, Russian drone strikes on a Chornobyl nuclear site, a high-stakes Ukraine summit in London, a blowout US jobs report rattling Wall Street, and a landmark cancer study headline the past 24 hours.

items.title: 7.8-Magnitude Earthquake Strikes Philippines, Killing at Least 19 and Triggering Tsunami Warnings
items.subtitle: NPR / Al Jazeera
items.summary: A powerful offshore quake hit southern Mindanao early Monday, killing at least 19 people, injuring more than 200, and sending a 1-meter tsunami into coastal villages. President Marcos declared emergency status, shut schools for 3.2 million students, and aftershocks as strong as 6.5 magnitude continued for hours.

items.title: Zelenskyy Meets Starmer, Macron, and Merz in London to Escalate Military Support
items.subtitle: NBC News
items.summary: Ukraine's top Western allies gathered in London to agree on scaling up interceptor production and co-developing anti-ballistic missile and deep-strike capabilities, the most concrete commitment to offensive aid since Russia fired Oreshnik hypersonic missiles at Ukrainian cities. The summit signals a shift from defensive to offensive posture among Ukraine's backers.

items.title: Russian Drone Strikes Chornobyl Nuclear-Waste Storage Facility
items.subtitle: Kyiv Post / Institute for the Study of War
items.summary: A Russian Shahed-type drone struck a nuclear-waste storage site near the Chornobyl Nuclear Power Plant in Kyiv Oblast overnight, while a barrage of 236 drones targeted cities across Ukraine. The Chornobyl strike raises immediate radiological concerns and follows Russia attacking two Ukrainian civilian search-and-rescue vessels in the Black Sea.

items.title: US May Jobs Report Doubles Expectations, Sending Stocks and Rate-Cut Hopes Lower
items.subtitle: Yahoo Finance / CNBC / Charles Schwab
items.summary: The US economy added 172,000 jobs in May—roughly twice what analysts forecast—while unemployment held at 4.3%, triggering a 'good news is bad news' market reaction: S&P 500 futures fell ~2.6%, Nasdaq futures dropped ~4.8%, and the 10-year Treasury yield surged to 4.54% as traders shelved Federal Reserve rate-cut bets.

items.title: GLP-1 Drugs Like Ozempic and Wegovy Linked to 30% Lower Breast Cancer Risk in Large Study
items.subtitle: Science News / SciTechDaily
items.summary: A large observational study found women taking GLP-1 receptor agonists—the drug class behind Ozempic, Wegovy, and Mounjaro—were about 30% less likely to develop breast cancer than comparable non-users. The finding adds to growing evidence that this class of diabetes and weight-loss drugs may have broad anti-cancer properties.
